question: Does the cursor rule PR #114 proposes (replay_cursor_slot) fix the faces issue #115 reports, when the SERVER is compliant (reconnect serves from the requested from_slot inclusively)?

sdk_sources.main_rule: helius-laserstream 2.0.0 (crates.io), client.rs cursor logic byte-identical to laserstream-sdk main 379a6ba
sdk_sources.pr114_rule: 2.0.0 + PR #114 diff (helius-labs/laserstream-sdk#114, branch bert/replay-cursor-from-delivered-update, head 708edd3) applied to src/client.rs; hunks 2-4 applied verbatim, import hunk applied by hand (identical content)

harness: github.com/auroraxo/laserstream-cursor-measure (mock geyser, no network, no keys; compliant mode honors from_slot inclusively)

faces.shape: user slot filter WITHOUT filter_by_commitment, PROCESSED tick @122 (#115 case 1)
user slot filter WITH filter_by_commitment, CONFIRMED tick @122 (#115 case 2)
tick tagged only with the SDK internal slot filter (what PR #114 addresses)
BLOCK FOOTER @122 on a user filter (main advances the cursor from it)
faces.pr114: fixed as a side effect (BlockFooter omitted from the rule)

faces.shape: footer-only subscription (no slot updates at all)
faces.pr114: zero loss BUT cursor never advances: every reconnect replays from first_available (permanent duplicates)

key_findings: PR #114 fixes the face its branch name/tests target (internal-only tick, C) and — as a side effect — the block-footer advance (D).

PR #114 does NOT fix the faces issue #115 is about: a USER slot update at live head (A without filter_by_commitment, B WITH filter_by_commitment — the documented correct usage) still advances the replay cursor to 122, and a compliant server then resumes at 122: slots 92..121 are never delivered. The rule is 'any non-internal-filter update advances', not 'only delivered payloads advance'.
PR #114's own tests cover exactly two cases (internal slot update ignored, delivered Block advances). The user-slot-tick face is untested in the PR.
New face on MAIN (not in #115): a BLOCK FOOTER at live head advances the cursor (footer_resume_slot), so a footer arriving ahead of payload replay also skips 92..121.

New face E: footer-only consumers lose their whole delivered range on MAIN; under PR #114 they keep at-least-once but the cursor never advances, so every reconnect replays from the server's first available slot.
honest_limits: Mock geyser, Rust SDK only; frequency on real LaserStream infrastructure not measured.
PR #114 applied to the 2.0.0 crate, not a live checkout of the PR branch; the diff is the PR's own rust/src/client.rs change (hunks 2-4 verbatim).
defect_present in each cell means cursor jumped past slot 91; the compliant-server delivered-slot lists are the user-zero evidence.
The E duplicate verdict assumes a server that replays from first_available on from_slot=None — the retention window determines duplicate volume, not correctness.

matrix.variant_label: D: BLOCK FOOTER at 122 on a user filter (the non-slot update that advances the cursor on main; PR #114's replay_cursor_slot omits BlockFooter)
matrix.script_text: payload@90, payload@91, BLOCK FOOTER@122 (user filter 'footers'), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: BLOCK FOOTER at live head advances the cursor to 122 (main's footer_resume_slot)

matrix.variant_label: E: FOOTER-ONLY subscription (footers 90, 91, live-head 122; no account payloads) — the live-head footer alone in the cursor
matrix.script_text: footer@90, footer@91, footer@122 (live head), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: footer-only consumer: cursor rides the live-head footer 122; 90..121 lost

matrix.variant_label: C: slot tick tagged ONLY with the SDK internal slot filter (the face PR #114 addresses)
matrix.explanation: internal-only tick advances the cursor to 122

matrix.variant_label: A: user slot filter without filter_by_commitment, tick status PROCESSED (issue #115 case 1)
matrix.script_text: payload@90, payload@91, PROCESSED slot tick @122 (user filter), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: cursor at 122; compliant server resumes at 122; 92..121 never delivered

matrix.variant_label: B: user slot filter with filter_by_commitment, tick status CONFIRMED == request commitment (issue #115 case 2)
matrix.script_text: payload@90, payload@91, CONFIRMED slot tick @122 (status == request commitment), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: same as A with the DOCUMENTED filter_by_commitment usage

matrix.variant_label: CONTROL: no slot update delivered at all (payload-only stream)
matrix.explanation: payload-only reconnects with from_slot=None: duplicates only (90,91 re-served), zero loss

matrix.variant_label: D: BLOCK FOOTER at 122 on a user filter (the non-slot update that advances the cursor on main; PR #114's replay_cursor_slot omits BlockFooter)
matrix.script_text: payload@90, payload@91, BLOCK FOOTER@122 (user filter 'footers'), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: fixed as a side effect: BlockFooter omitted from replay_cursor_slot; from=91

matrix.variant_label: C: slot tick tagged ONLY with the SDK internal slot filter (the face PR #114 addresses)
matrix.explanation: PR #114's own claim, verified: internal-only tick ignored; from=91

matrix.variant_label: B: user slot filter with filter_by_commitment, tick status CONFIRMED == request commitment (issue #115 case 2)
matrix.script_text: payload@90, payload@91, CONFIRMED slot tick @122 (status == request commitment), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: user slot tick with filter_by_commitment STILL advances the cursor — the #115 case-2 face survives the fix

matrix.variant_label: A: user slot filter without filter_by_commitment, tick status PROCESSED (issue #115 case 1)
matrix.script_text: payload@90, payload@91, PROCESSED slot tick @122 (user filter), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: USER slot tick still advances the cursor under PR #114's rule (non-internal filters advance) — the #115 case-1 face survives the fix

matrix.variant_label: E: FOOTER-ONLY subscription (footers 90, 91, live-head 122; no account payloads) — the live-head footer alone in the cursor
matrix.script_text: footer@90, footer@91, footer@122 (live head), stream end -> reconnect
matrix.explanation: cursor never advances (footer-only, no slot updates): tracked_slot stays 0, from_slot=None on every reconnect; server replays from first_available — zero loss, permanent duplicates

matrix.variant_label: CONTROL: no slot update delivered at all (payload-only stream)
matrix.explanation: from=91: payload slots now advance the cursor; one duplicate (91), zero loss
